breast-augmentation.name: Breast Augmentation
breast-augmentation.title: Breast Augmentation
breast-augmentation.description: Breast Augmentation with Dr. Alan T. Tran in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Book your consultation today!

sections.x: During your consultation, Dr. Tran will discuss with you the goals of the surgery and will explain your options such as implant styles, types, sizes, incision location, and whether the implant should be placed below or above the muscle. You will be able to try on implants of different sizes to see which look best on you.
Are You a Candidate for Breast Augmentation?
You may need breast augmentation if your breast:

items: Has lost shape and volume due to aging, weight loss, or pregnancy
Requires symmetry in terms of shape and/or size
Requires projection, additional volume to maintain a balance of the upper torso in terms of proportion with the hips

sections.x: Breast Augmentation Consultation

The first step in breast augmentation surgery is to visit our clinic for a consultation. You will spend quality time with Dr. Tran, a board-certified plastic surgeon, who will address all your questions regarding the surgery, the implants, and the post-surgery recovery. During consultation we will assess and discuss:

items: Your expectations from the procedure and desired results
Your current medical condition, medications and allergies
An examination of the patient’s breasts to determine the best implants for the patient’s body shape to achieve the desired result

sections.x: For your benefits of understanding, our staff will also compare before and after photos of our former patients so that you can get a clear idea of what kind of results that may be expected from the surgery.
Breast Augmentation Procedure

The breast augmentation surgery generally lasts for about 1.5 hours. The details of surgical planning including implant choice, incision choice, and placement of the implant will be discussed and reviewed with the patient during the pre-operative consultation.

There are two most common types of incisions used by the surgeons for breast augmentation. The type of incision to be used in the procedure is chosen after considering several factors including, the current shape and size of the breast, the shape and size of the breast implant, preference of the patient, the type of implant, and the surgeon’s preference.
Periareolar Incision:

This incision is made on the outer edge or just within the areola, which is the darker skin around the nipple. Once the incision is made following the curve of the areola, a pocket is created through which the implant is slid into the breast.
Inframammary Incision:
This incision is made horizontally underneath the fold of each breast, where the lower part of the breast meets the chest wall.
Breast Implants Types

The breast augmentation surgery is not a one-size-fits-all procedure and needs to be customized in accordance with your requirements, needs, anatomy, and health. The breast implants come in various sizes, profiles, and shapes. During the initial consultation, we will discuss the breast implant choices with the patient to help you achieve the desired results.
Silicone Breast Implants (gel):

Silicone breast implants consist of a solid silicone outer shell filled with cohesive silicone gel. All silicone breast implants are pre-filled with this naturally occurring element and may require a longer incision to insert the implant (than with saline implant). However, the general consensus is that silicone breast implants feel more natural and lighter than its saline counterpart.
Saline Breast Implants (Salt water):

Saline breast implants, on the other hand, consists of an empty shell made of silicone which is filled with sterile saltwater mixture once the implant is placed inside the patient’s breast. The implants are filled with the salt water solution at the time of the surgery. Hence, the implant can be placed inside through a comparatively small incision.
Gummy Bear Implants (Highly cohesive gel):

The Gummy bear breast implant is a new product that is being used for breast augmentation and reconstruction surgeries. These implants consist of a silicone outer shell, similar to the silicone breast implants, pre-filled with highly cohesive (thicker consistency) silicone gel.
Breast Implant Shapes and Sizes
There are two common breast implants shapes: teardrop and round. Dr. Alan Tran will help you determine the best choice of implant shape for you.
Teardrop Shaped Breast Implant:
This breast implant comes in the anatomic shape like a teardrop and consists of a more cohesive silicone gel fill. The outer shell is mostly textured to lessen implant mobility/rotation risk.
Round Shaped Breast Implant:
This implant has a round base and comes in variable projections and base diameters. The fill may be silicone gel or Saline (salt water).
Teardrop Shaped Breast Implant:
This breast implant comes in the anatomic shape like a teardrop and consists of a more cohesive silicone gel fill. The outer shell is mostly textured to lessen implant mobility/rotation risk.
Preparations for the Breast Augmentation Surgery
In preparation for breast augmentation surgery, our team at Dr. Alan T. Tran Plastic Surgery will provide you with a set of instructions to follow before surgery:

items: A mammogram of all patients above 40 years of age
Smoking cessation before and after surgery
Avoid any kind of anti-inflammatory drugs 2 weeks prior to the procedure; please see list of other medications to avoid
Arrange for personal transportation to reach home after the procedure as you cannot be sent home unaccompanied in an Uber type service or taxi

sections.x: What to expect after your Breast Augmentation Surgery?

Dr. Alan T. Tran Plastic Surgery team will follow the progress of our patients closely to ensure a smooth recovery from surgery. At the pre-operative visit, you will be given written instructions regarding:

items: Wear foam compression wrap for 1 week
No lifting arms overhead, pushing or pulling for 2 weeks
Submitting the breast implant registry documents within 30 days
Recovery time: 1-2 weeks (depending on type of work and each individual’s recovery)

breast-augmentation.closing: We look forward to helping you achieve your best natural look!

breast-lift.name: Breast Lift
breast-lift.title: Breast Lift
breast-lift.description: Breast Lift with Dr. Alan T. Tran in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Book your consultation today!

sections.x: A breast lift, also known as mastopexy, is a surgical procedure designed to raise and reshape sagging breasts by removing excess skin and tightening the surrounding tissue. A breast lift restores a more youthful breast contour and improves breast position without significantly changing breast size.
Changes in the breasts can occur due to pregnancy, breastfeeding, aging, weight fluctuations, and genetics.
You may be a candidate for a breast lift if your breasts:

items: Sag or droop due to aging, pregnancy, or weight loss
Have nipples that point downward or sit below the breast crease
Have stretched skin and enlarged areolas

sections.x: Breast lift consultation
The first step in breast lift surgery is scheduling a consultation with Dr. Tran. During your consultation, we will discuss:

items: Breast anatomy, skin elasticity, and nipple position

sections.x: Our staff will also review before and after photos of previous breast lift patients to help you better understand potential outcomes.
Breast lift procedure

Breast lift surgery is customized based on each patient’s anatomy and desired result. The procedure generally involves removing excess skin, reshaping breast tissue, and repositioning the nipples to create a firmer and more youthful appearance.
Breast lift incision techniques
Periareolar lift
An incision is made around the areola to address mild breast sagging and improve nipple position.
Anchor lift
For more significant breast sagging, an additional incision is placed along the breast crease to allow greater reshaping and tightening.
Preparing for your breast lift surgery
Before surgery, patients may be instructed to:

items: Stop smoking before and after surgery

sections.x: What to expect after your breast lift surgery
Following surgery, patients receive detailed postoperative instructions regarding:

items: Surgical bra or compression garment usage

sections.x: Breast lift recovery

Swelling, bruising, and temporary soreness are common during the initial recovery period. Most patients return to light activities within one to two weeks, though strenuous exercise should be avoided during early healing.
Breast lift results

As swelling improves, patients notice firmer, more elevated, and youthful breast contours. Results are long lasting but may continue to change naturally with aging, pregnancy, and weight fluctuations.

breast-lift.closing: We look forward to helping you achieve your best natural look!

breast-reduction.title: Breast Reduction

sections.x: Breast reduction surgery reduces the size and weight of overly large breasts to improve comfort, body proportions, and quality of life. The procedure removes excess breast tissue, fat, and skin while reshaping the breasts for a more balanced appearance.
Breast reduction may also help relieve physical symptoms associated with overly large breasts.
You may be a candidate for breast reduction if you experience:

items: Chronic neck, back, or shoulder pain
Difficulty exercising or participating in physical activities
Breasts that feel disproportionately large for your body frame

sections.x: Breast reduction consultation
During your consultation, we will discuss:

items: Your goals and desired breast size

sections.x: Dr. Tran and his team will review before and after photos to help you understand the expected outcomes of breast reduction surgery.
Breast reduction procedure
Breast reduction surgery involves removing excess breast tissue, fat, and skin while repositioning the nipples and reshaping the breasts to achieve a smaller, more lifted appearance.
Liposuction may also be used in selected patients to improve contour.
Preparing for your breast reduction surgery
Before surgery, patients may be instructed to:

items: Stop smoking before and after surgery

sections.x: What to expect after your breast reduction surgery
Following surgery, patients receive detailed instructions regarding:
Breast reduction recovery
Swelling, bruising, and soreness are expected during the initial healing phase. Most patients return to light activities within one to two weeks and gradually resume normal activities over time.
Breast reduction results
Patients often experience immediate relief from discomfort and improved body proportions following surgery. As healing progresses, the breasts appear lighter, firmer, and more balanced.

Breast revision results

breast-reconstruction.name: Breast Reconstruction
breast-reconstruction.title: Breast Reconstruction
breast-reconstruction.description: Breast Reconstruction with Dr. Alan T. Tran in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Book your consultation today!

sections.x: Breast reconstruction surgery restores the shape and appearance of the breast following mastectomy, lumpectomy, trauma, or congenital conditions. Reconstruction can help patients regain confidence and restore body balance after breast cancer treatment or breast loss.
Dr. Tran offers personalized breast reconstruction options tailored to each patient’s anatomy, health, and goals.
You may be a candidate for breast reconstruction if you:

items: Have breast asymmetry after cancer treatment
Desire restoration of breast shape and contour
Have congenital breast deformities or trauma-related changes
Are seeking delayed or immediate reconstruction options

sections.x: Breast reconstruction consultation
During your consultation we will discuss:

items: Medical history, cancer treatment history, and medications

sections.x: Dr. Tran will create a customized reconstruction plan based on your needs and treatment history.
Breast reconstruction options
Implant-based reconstruction
Breast implants may be used to restore breast shape and volume following mastectomy or breast tissue loss.
Tissue flap reconstruction
Tissue from another area of the body may be used to recreate the breast mound for a more natural reconstruction.
Combination reconstruction
In some cases, reconstruction may combine implants with the patient’s own tissue to achieve optimal results.
Preparing for your breast reconstruction surgery
Before surgery, patients may be instructed to:

items: Obtain medical clearance or imaging studies if necessary
Stop smoking before and after surgery

sections.x: What to expect after your breast reconstruction surgery
Following surgery, patients receive detailed postoperative instructions including:

items: Drain and incision care if necessary

sections.x: Breast reconstruction recovery
Recovery varies depending on the type of reconstruction performed. Swelling, soreness, and temporary fatigue are common during the healing process.
Breast reconstruction results

As healing progresses, patients experience improved breast contour, symmetry, and confidence. Breast reconstruction can play an important role in emotional and physical recovery following breast cancer treatment.

breast-reconstruction.closing: We look forward to helping you achieve your best natural look!

During your consultation we will discuss:

Breast lumpectomy procedure

The procedure involves carefully removing the breast lump or abnormal tissue while preserving surrounding healthy tissue whenever possible. The surgical approach is planned to minimize visible scarring and maintain breast contour.

Before surgery, patients may be instructed to:

items: Obtain imaging studies or lab testing if necessary
Stop smoking before and after surgery
Avoid medications that increase bleeding risk

Following surgery, patients receive instructions regarding:

Breast lumpectomy results
The goal of lumpectomy is to safely remove abnormal tissue while preserving the natural appearance of the breast whenever possible.

tummy-tuck-abdominoplasty.name: Tummy Tuck (Abdominoplasty)
tummy-tuck-abdominoplasty.title: Tummy Tuck (Abdominoplasty)
tummy-tuck-abdominoplasty.description: Tummy Tuck (Abdominoplasty) with Dr. Alan T. Tran in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Book your consultation today!

sections.x: A tummy tuck, also known as abdominoplasty, removes excess fat and skin from the lower abdomen and repairs separated/stretched abdominal muscles. It contours the abdomen for a slimmer, firmer appearance. Tummy tuck can help to reverse changes caused by various factors:

Tummy tuck results are permanent but can be affected by fluctuations in weight or health condition. Individuals who are planning a pregnancy or to lose large amount of weight may want to delay a tummy tuck surgery.
Are you a candidate for tummy tuck?
Patients seeking a tummy tuck usually have one or more of the following conditions:

items: Excess skin and fat in the abdomen
Not planning on becoming pregnant or losing a large amount of weight in the near future

sections.x: Your tummy tuck consultation.

The first step in tummy tuck surgery is to visit our clinic for a consultation. You will spend quality time with Dr. Tran, a board-certified plastic surgeon, who will address all your questions regarding the surgery, and the post-surgery recovery.
During consultation we will examine and discuss:

items: Why you want tummy tuck surgery, including your preferences, expectations, and desired outcome
Medical history, drug allergies, and medications

sections.x: In addition, you will be shown many before and after photos of our past patients who have undergone abdominoplasty so you will have a better understanding of the results you may expect to attain.
Preparing For Your Tummy Tuck Procedure
Prior to the tummy tuck surgery, our team at Dr. Alan T. Tran Plastic Surgery will provide you with a set of instructions to follow before and after surgery:

items: Get lab testing and/or a medical evaluation
Stop smoking for a minimum of 6 weeks before the surgery and 6 weeks after the surgical procedure
Avoid any kind of anti-inflammatory drugs 2 weeks prior to the procedure; please see list of other medications to avoid
Arrange for personal transportation to reach home after the procedure as you cannot be sent home unaccompanied in an Uber type service or taxi

sections.x: Techniques
There are different surgical techniques that the surgeon can perform depending on each patient’s individual needs and preferences.
Full Tummy Tuck

A horizontal incision is made at or near the natural crease in the lower abdomen. A second incision around the belly button may be necessary to remove excess skin in the upper abdomen and reposition the belly button. After the excess fat and tissue from the upper and lower regions of the abdomen are removed, the abdominal muscles are tightened, the belly button is repositioned/reshaped and the incisions are closed with sutures.
Mini Tummy Tuck

A short incision is made above the pubic bone and excess fat and skin are removed. After the lower abdominal muscles are tightened, the incision is closed with sutures. The belly button is not cut or reshaped.
Fleur-de-Lis Tummy Tuck

A horizontal incision is made in the pubic hairline and a vertical incision is made that extends up the torso. Candidates for this type of procedure have usually already lost a significant amount of weight or have had bariatric surgery.
What to expect after your Tummy Tuck surgery?

items: Wear binder and foam compression for approximately 2-3 weeks
Application of scar reduction topicals or dressings 1-2 weeks after surgery
Return to light duty work in approximately 7-10 days

tummy-tuck-abdominoplasty.closing: We look forward to helping you achieve your best natural look!

liposuction.name: Liposuction
liposuction.title: Liposuction
liposuction.description: Liposuction with Dr. Alan T. Tran in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Book your consultation today!

sections.x: Liposuction is a surgical procedure whereby fat between the skin and muscle layers is removed from the body through small skin incisions.
You may be a candidate for liposuction if you:

items: Have areas of your body that are not in proportion to the rest of your body
Have areas of stubborn fat that do not go away with regular exercise and a healthy diet
Have skin that is firm with good elasticity
Desire to contour and tone up your body in certain areas

sections.x: Initial liposuction consultation

The first step in liposuction surgery is to visit our clinic for a consultation. You will spend quality time with Dr. Tran, a board-certified plastic surgeon, who will address all your questions regarding the surgery, and the post-surgery recovery.
During consultation we will evaluate and discuss:
Our staff will show you before and after photos of past patients who have undergone liposuction treatment so you will have a better understanding of the results you can expect to attain.
Preparing for Liposuction surgery
Before liposuction surgery, our team at Dr. Alan T. Tran Plastic Surgery will provide you with a set of instructions:

items: Pre-operative lab testing and medical evaluation
Stop smoking before and after surgery
Avoid any kind of anti-inflammatory drugs 2 weeks prior to the procedure; please see list of other medications to avoid
Arrange for personal transportation to reach home after the procedure as you cannot be sent home unaccompanied in an Uber type service or taxi

sections.x: Dr. Alan Tran has the qualifications and experience necessary to perform your liposuction treatment with safety and effectiveness. Liposuction is usually performed on an outpatient basis. Your liposuction procedure may be performed in office (small or limited areas and volumes) or at a surgical center. If your procedure is performed on an outpatient basis, you will need to make arrangements for someone to drive you to and from surgery and to stay with you for at least one night following surgery.
Procedure
Incisions placement

Liposuction is performed through small, inconspicuous incisions. Before any incision is made, local anesthesia is injected to numb the skin. These tiny skin incisions are placed in the targeted areas where fat deposits will be removed.
Fat Grafting (optional)

Unlike SmartLipo (laser), CoolSculpting (freezing fat), or UAL (ultrasonic), which destroy fat cells and render them useless, PAL (power-assisted liposuction) gives the patient the option of grafting viable fat to other areas of the body, such as the face and/or buttocks, for enhancement.
Removing fat

Through the skin incisions, a sterile liquid solution will be infused to numb the areas to be treated and reduce bleeding. A thin hollow tube, called a cannula, will be inserted through the incisions and advanced underneath the skin to loosen excess fat using a controlled back and forth motion. The fat may be broken up with power oscillation. The dislodged fat will be suctioned out of the body using a surgical vacuum or syringe attached to the cannula, removing them permanently from your body.
Recovery time

items: After your liposuction surgery is completed, your body may be wrapped with foam and elastic binders/bandages to help minimize swelling and compress the skin to your new body contours.

Postoperative pain: many patients state that the area feels sore, as if they underwent a vigorous workout, but prescribed medication will help lessen these symptoms. The recovery time for liposuction varies for each person. Most patients can return to work after about a week but should refrain from any strenuous activity or exercise for two to three weeks
During the first 48 hours following surgery, patients experience varying degrees of swelling and bruising. The swelling persists longer. Bruising typically disappears within seven to ten days.
Your weight may temporarily increase immediately after surgery due to swelling and fluid retention. This phenomenon usually dissipates over the next several weeks.
The small incisions used for access of the suction cannula will fade over a few months usually becoming barely visible.

sections.x: Results

The results of your liposuction procedure will become noticeable over the weeks and months after surgery as the swelling subsides. Patients are usually very happy with the outcome of their procedure and have an increase in self confidence. Often, patients find that they can wear certain clothing that was not possible before liposuction.

The results of liposuction surgery are technically permanent because the fat cells have been removed. However, your body shape and contours might be affected by weight gain, aging, pregnancy, family genetics, and lifestyle factors. It is crucial to maintain healthy habits and a stable weight to prolong the results from liposuction. To learn more about Liposuction and whether you are a candidate for this procedure, schedule a consultation today.

liposuction.closing: We look forward to helping you achieve your best natural look!

fat-transfer-grafting.name: Fat Transfer/Grafting
fat-transfer-grafting.title: Fat Transfer/Grafting
fat-transfer-grafting.description: Fat Transfer/Grafting with Dr. Alan T. Tran in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Book your consultation today!

sections.x: Fat transfer, also known as fat grafting, is a procedure that uses your body’s own fat to restore volume, improve contours, and enhance certain areas of the body or face. Fat is gently removed through liposuction, purified, and strategically injected into targeted areas for natural-looking enhancement.
Fat transfer can be used to rejuvenate the face, improve body contours, and enhance areas such as the buttocks, breasts, hands, or hips.
You may be a candidate for fat transfer if:

items: You have areas of volume loss due to aging or weight changes
You want to improve facial or body contours
You prefer using your own fat instead of implants or synthetic fillers
You have adequate donor fat available for transfer

sections.x: Fat transfer consultation
At your consultation we will discuss:
Dr. Tran will evaluate your anatomy and develop a customized treatment plan tailored to your goals.
Preparing for your fat transfer procedure
Before surgery, patients may be instructed to:

items: Stop smoking before and after surgery

sections.x: Fat transfer procedure
Fat harvesting
Fat is gently removed from donor areas such as the abdomen, thighs, or flanks using liposuction techniques.
Fat purification
The harvested fat is processed and purified to isolate healthy fat cells for transfer.
Fat injection
The purified fat is strategically injected into the treatment area to restore volume and improve contour.
What to expect after your fat transfer procedure
Following treatment, patients may receive instructions regarding:
Fat transfer recovery
Swelling and bruising are expected in both the donor and treated areas. Most patients return to normal activities within one to two weeks depending on the extent of treatment.
Fat transfer results

As swelling subsides, patients enjoy natural-looking volume enhancement and improved body contours. Some transferred fat is naturally absorbed by the body, while the remaining fat may provide long-lasting results.
The first step toward natural enhancement is scheduling a consultation with Dr. Tran to discuss your personalized treatment plan.

fat-transfer-grafting.closing: We look forward to helping you achieve beautifully balanced results!

brazilian-butt-lift-fat-grafting.name: Brazilian Butt Lift (Fat Grafting)
brazilian-butt-lift-fat-grafting.title: Brazilian Butt Lift (Fat Grafting)
brazilian-butt-lift-fat-grafting.description: Brazilian Butt Lift (Fat Grafting) with Dr. Alan T. Tran in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Book your consultation today!

sections.x: A Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) enhances the shape and volume of the buttocks using your body’s own fat. Fat is removed from areas such as the abdomen, waist, back, or thighs through liposuction and strategically transferred to the buttocks to create fuller, more sculpted contours.
This procedure enhances body proportions while also contouring donor areas for a more balanced silhouette.
You may be a candidate for a Brazilian Butt Lift if:

items: You desire fuller or more rounded buttocks
You want improved body proportions and contour
You have areas of excess fat suitable for transfer
You prefer natural enhancement without implants
You maintain a stable weight and healthy lifestyle

sections.x: Brazilian Butt Lift consultation
At your consultation we will discuss:

items: Donor areas and desired buttock shape

sections.x: Dr. Tran will evaluate your anatomy and create a customized surgical plan to achieve natural-looking results.
Preparing for your Brazilian Butt Lift procedure
Before surgery, patients may be instructed to:

items: Obtain lab testing or medical clearance
Stop smoking before and after surgery

sections.x: Brazilian Butt Lift procedure
Liposuction
Excess fat is removed from selected donor areas to sculpt the body and collect fat for transfer.
Fat purification
The harvested fat is processed and purified before reinjection.
Fat grafting
The purified fat is strategically injected into the buttocks to improve shape, projection, and symmetry.
What to expect after your Brazilian Butt Lift procedure
After surgery, patients receive detailed postoperative instructions that may include:

items: Avoiding pressure on the buttocks during healing

sections.x: Brazilian Butt Lift recovery

Swelling, bruising, and soreness are expected during the initial recovery period. Most patients return to light activities within one to two weeks but must avoid prolonged sitting directly on the buttocks for several weeks.

sections.x: More and more people are turning to non-surgical injectables and fillers as alternatives to or to delay surgical procedures. Treatments like Botox, Radiesse, Juvéderm or Belotero offer both men and women the ability to erase the signs of aging and achieve a younger look without surgery or lengthy recovery. Our non-surgical treatments are perfect options for active men and women who are looking for a quick way to a youthful appearance.
We provide the following injectable and filler treatments:
Botox (Botulinum Toxin) injectables

When we make expressions with our faces, our skin is being pulled and folded over. Over time this leads to the formation of lines and wrinkles. Injectable treatments like Botox and Xeomin use a purified protein known as botulinum toxin type A to relax the face’s underlying muscles and smooth out surface lines and wrinkles such as frown lines and crow’s feet.
Botox will not fill in volume loss or hollow areas.
We offer the following injectable treatments:
Dermal fillers

Dermal fillers (unlike Botox injectables) are injected beneath the skin to fill in signs of aging, such as lines, wrinkles, folds, and areas of volume loss. These fillers are made of hyaluronic acid or calcium hydroxylapatite and used to treat a wide range of conditions, including nasolabial folds, sunken cheeks, and even thinning lips.
We offer the following dermal fillers:

items: Juvéderm Ultra Plus XC – This hyaluronic acid filler is indicated for lines and wrinkles around the nose and mouth (laugh lines). It may also be used for deep lines between the eyebrows (the number 11), forehead and to achieve fuller lips.
Radiesse – This calcium hydroxylapatite filler is used to restore volume, “lift” the face and fill hollow cheeks. It may also be injected to fill the tear troughs and back of the hands.
Belotero – A less viscous filler for fine lines on the face, especially around the eyes

sections.x: Non-surgical facelift
A non-surgical facelift uses a customized combination of injectables and fillers to treat various areas in the face to restore a more youthful appearance.
What to expect at your consultation

items: Your anatomy, skin condition, medical history and expectation of outcome will be evaluated and discussed with Dr. Alan Tran
Informed consent and photographic documentation will be obtained
Topical anesthesia and ice will be applied to the areas to be treated
Patients with history of easy bruising will be given medication to limit bruising

Dr. Alan Tran will administer the injectable/filler and the patient will be asked for input as the procedure progresses until completion. In some cases, several sessions (6-8 weeks apart) may be necessary to achieve optimal outcome naturally.

Most patients may return to work or daily activities on the same day. Patients with Botox will need to refrain from exercises or lying down for 6 hours. Ice application to the treated areas and elevation of the head on 2 pillows for 1-2 days after the procedure will help limit swelling and bruising.

Patients with fillers will be shown how to massage the treated areas several times a day in the first 2 days after procedure. This will facilitate blending of the filler into the skin. Those with large volume of fillers may want to rest the evening after the procedure. Bruising occasionally occurs 1-2 days after injectable treatment and usually lasts for 1 week. Most of the time it is minor and may be concealed with make-up.

sections.x: Blepharoplasty (eyelid surgery) is a surgical procedure to shape or recontour the eyelids. It may restore the eyelids to a more youthful appearance after changes due to age, medical condition, exposure to harsh environment or trauma. In the Asian patient, blepharoplasty may be used to create a fold in the upper eyelid (“double eyelids”).
You may be a candidate for eyelid surgery if:

sections.x: Eyelid consultation

items: Why you want eyelid surgery and expectations

sections.x: Dr. Tran and his team will show you before and after photos of past patients who have undergone eyelid surgery to help you gain a better understanding of the results you may expect to attain.
Preparing for your eyelid procedure

Prior to the eyelid surgery, our team at Dr. Alan T. Tran Plastic Surgery will provide you with a set of instructions that the patient must abide by before the surgery. Some of the instructions include:

items: Get lab testing and/or a medical evaluation
Stop smoking at least four weeks before and after surgery
Avoid taking any anti-inflammatory drugs, such as aspirin, as these can increase your risk for bleeding
Arrange for someone to drive you home after this procedure

sections.x: Eyelid surgery techniques
There are several incision techniques that can be performed for eyelid surgery. Your surgeon will help you decide on a method that is right for you based on the anatomy and condition of your eyelids.
Upper blepharoplasty

An incision is made in the natural fold of the upper eyelids so that it is hidden from sight. After the incision is made, the surgeon will remove excess skin and tissue while tightening the remaining skin and sculpting fat to achieve a more youthful eye appearance.
If a double eyelid appearance is desired, the incision closure will be anchored to the upper eyelid levator (lifting) mechanism to create this fold.
Lower blepharoplasty

Dr. Tran may make an incision just below the lower eyelashes, where excess skin will be removed if necessary. An inner eyelid incision may be made within the lower eyelid to reposition fat and improve puffiness under the eyes. Fat may be taken to fill the tear trough hollowness if needed.
Incision closure
Once the desired amount of excess skin has been removed and fat has been redistributed and sculpted, the incisions are closed with sutures. The incisions are taped.
What to expect after your eyelid procedure
After your eyelid procedure is complete, you will be provided with specific instructions, including:

items: Postoperative care to follow at home

sections.x: Eyelid surgery recovery

After the procedure is complete, bandages will be applied to the eye area to help reduce swelling. Prescribed medication can be taken to alleviate the pain or soreness that exists. The time to recover from eyelid surgery is different for everyone. Generally, most patients return to work after about a week, but strenuous activity should be refrained from for at least two weeks after surgery.
Eyelid surgery results

It will take several weeks when the incisions heal and swelling resolves to see the result of your eyelid surgery. Incisions will fade over a few months usually becoming barely visible. The results of aesthetic eyelid surgery are usually long lasting, but they may be affected by heredity and lifestyle factors. Removal of fat from your eyelids, which is usually the cause of puffiness and bags, is permanent and usually will not recur. However, the skin continues to age and skin laxity along with the fine wrinkling of the eyelid area may return. Sometimes loss of tone in the forehead causes sagging of the eyebrows which mimics a recurrence of drooping upper eyelids. Correction of this condition may require a forehead lift or a secondary eyelid procedure. Even though the aging process continues, patients are generally very happy with their appearance for many years following eyelid surgery.

The first step in eyelid surgery is to visit our clinic for a consultation. You will spend quality time with Dr. Tran, a board-certified plastic surgeon, who will address all your questions regarding the surgery, and the post-surgery recovery.

Open rhinoplasty
A small incision is placed across the columella (the tissue between the nostrils) to allow full access to the nasal structures. This technique provides greater precision for more complex reshaping.
Closed rhinoplasty

Functional rhinoplasty

Incision closure
Once the nasal reshaping is complete, the incisions are carefully closed with sutures. A splint may be placed on the nose to support healing and maintain the new contour.

What to expect after your neck lift procedure
Following surgery, patients receive detailed postoperative instructions, including:
Neck lift recovery

Swelling and bruising are expected during the early healing phase. Most patients return to work and light activities within one to two weeks, though strenuous activity should be avoided for several weeks.
Neck lift results
As healing progresses, patients notice a smoother, firmer neck contour and improved jawline definition. Neck lift results are long lasting and help restore a more youthful appearance.
The first step toward neck rejuvenation is scheduling a consultation with Dr. Tran to discuss your goals and treatment options.

brow-lift.title: Brow Lift
brow-lift.description: Brow Lift with Dr. Alan T. Tran in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Book your consultation today!

sections.x: A brow lift, also known as a forehead lift, is a surgical procedure designed to elevate the brows and reduce signs of aging in the forehead area. A brow lift can smooth forehead wrinkles, improve frown lines, and restore a more refreshed and youthful appearance.
You may be a candidate for a brow lift if:

items: You have sagging or drooping eyebrows
You notice deep forehead wrinkles or furrows
You have frown lines between the eyebrows
You appear tired, angry, or stressed due to brow position
You want a more refreshed and youthful appearance

sections.x: Brow lift consultation
At your consultation we will discuss:
Dr. Tran and his team will review before and after photos to help you understand the results that may be possible.
Preparing for your brow lift procedure
Prior to surgery, patients may be instructed to:

items: Stop smoking before and after surgery
Prepare for recovery time at home

sections.x: Brow lift techniques
Endoscopic brow lift
This minimally invasive technique uses small incisions hidden within the hairline and specialized instruments to reposition the brow and smooth forehead tissues.
Traditional brow lift
A traditional brow lift uses a longer incision hidden behind the hairline to address more significant brow sagging and forehead aging.
Temporal brow lift
This technique focuses on lifting the outer portion of the brows for subtle rejuvenation and improved eye appearance.
Incision closure
After repositioning the brows and smoothing the forehead tissues, the incisions are carefully closed with sutures or surgical clips.
What to expect after your brow lift procedure
After surgery, you will receive postoperative instructions that include:
Brow lift recovery
Swelling, bruising, and temporary tightness are common after a brow lift. Most patients return to normal activities within one to two weeks, although complete healing continues over time.
Brow lift results
As swelling resolves, patients enjoy a smoother forehead, elevated brows, and a more youthful, refreshed appearance. Brow lift results are long lasting and can significantly improve facial harmony.
The first step toward brow rejuvenation is scheduling a consultation with Dr. Tran to discuss your personalized treatment plan.

brow-lift.closing: We look forward to helping you achieve naturally refreshed results!

about.title: About Dr. Alan Tran
about.welcome: Helping you achieve your best natural look is our number one goal. When you visit Alan T. Tran, M.D. Plastic Surgery, you will spend quality time with me, Dr. Alan Tran. Your desired appearance and questions regarding treatments and outcome will be thoroughly addressed. You will find me to be personable and attentive. I will help you choose the best personalized treatment to achieve the look you have always desired. We look forward to seeing you in our office.
who: Dr. Alan T. Tran is a board-certified plastic and reconstructive surgeon who has been practicing in Orange County since the year 2000. He was also board certified in General Surgery. Dr. Alan Tran is a compassionate physician who brings his artistic talent, attention to detail and excellent hand skills to plastic surgery. His patients receive modern medicine practiced with a “small town” Oklahoma personal touch.

Dr. Tran’s practice is wide in scope and deep in breadth. His [cosmetic practice](/services/) encompasses [breast surgery](/services/#breast), [body contouring](/services/body-contouring/), and [facial aesthetics](/services/#face). Utilizing established and innovative surgical techniques along with a wide selection of non-surgical treatments, we help our patients achieve their best natural appearances. Our patients are offered individualized treatment plans that best address their needs safely and optimally.

His reconstructive surgery practice includes [breast reconstruction](/services/breast-reconstruction/), [skin cancer reconstruction](/services/skin-cancer-treatments/), and [scar revision](/services/keloid-scar-treatment/). In treating these conditions, modern medicine is integrated with aesthetic surgery to achieve excellent medical treatment of the primary disease without compromising the aesthetic outcome.

Dr. Alan Tran’s special project – that is near and dear to his heart – is children born with cleft lip and palate. Since 2002, Dr. Tran has devoted nearly one fifth of his practice to the care of these special-needs children. Much of this time is spent in East Los Angeles at White Memorial Medical Center serving the underprivileged children born with these birth defects. To him, all these patients are his children and Dr. Tran is deeply invested in seeing that they can escape the deformity and stigma that come with their congenital condition.
In addition, Dr. Tran sponsors many outreach programs to other countries throughout the world to treat similar conditions.
